context_requirements: Expression of sigma-1 receptor (SIGMAR1) or sigma-2 receptor (TMEM97/SIGMAR2)
Tumour cell context; normal/immortalised non-transformed cells respond weakly
Functional p53 enhances apoptotic and HIF-1alpha-mediated responses
Intact intracellular calcium stores and ER stress machinery
falsifiers: No consistent transcriptional response across any of the nine cell lines at 6 h or 24 h
Absence of HIF1A, BNIP3, or BNIP3L induction at 24 h in responsive lines
No induction of stress/ER/UPR genes (e.g., DDIT4, TRIB3, HSPA1A) at either time point
Strong proliferation signature without any apoptotic or stress component
Responses equal in HA1E (non-transformed) and tumour lines

evidence.supports: Sigma receptor ligand reduced haloperidol induces apoptosis and increases intracellular calcium in colon and mammary adenocarcinoma cells
Sigma receptor ligand CM156 reverses cocaine-induced transcriptional responses in mouse brain
Selective sigma receptor ligand EMD 57445 induces c-fos gene expression in rat brain
Sigma receptor ligand SN79 attenuates oxidative stress, ER stress, and apoptosis in differentiated NG108-15 cells
Sigma receptor antagonist rimcazole elevates HIF-1alpha and induces tumour-selective apoptosis
